;; Capture happy path (R1 and the carried-tile idiom).
;; `step` moves G east over floor it does not destroy: variable 1 reads the
;; carried tile from the register behind `!`, variable 2 captures the tile
;; being stepped onto, and the register swap keeps them consistent.
;; `merge` demonstrates within-pattern equality: `11` only matches two
;; adjacent EQUAL cells, so the AB pair is skipped and AA becomes AE.

CLASS floor -.

GOAL
GE

!.G.-E
#AB#AA

BIND d step "east" m merge "merge"

CMD step
 ATOMIC 1 floor 2 floor
  !1

  G2 1G

  !1 !2

CMD merge
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  11 1E
